user.title: New tank
user.description: The slug becomes the entity_id prefix (e.g. `reef` gives `button.reef_start_feed`). Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only, starting with a letter.

hardware.title: Tank hardware
hardware.description: Pick the entities for this tank's equipment. Any brand works as long as the device shows up as a switch or fan entity. Return pump speed controls and the power sensor are optional.

data.pump_speed_controls: Return pump speed control(s) (optional, number entities)
data.power_sensor: Mains/UPS power sensor (optional, enables power-loss skimmer delay)

error.invalid_slug: Slug must be lowercase letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter.

abort.already_configured: A tank with this slug already exists.

init.title: Rewire tank hardware
init.description: Change which entities this tank's automations control — e.g. swap demo entities for real hardware. Settings sliders and history are kept.
